THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land described in below name and extent depicted in Surveyor General's Advance Tracing No. MA/NUL/2019/74 dated 04.06.2019, situated at Pallehaduwa Village (FVP 260) in Wagapanaha Udasiya Pattuwa Minor Division of Naula Divisional Secretary's Division, Matale District, Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ - Kolongollehena - Extent: 0.0743 Hectare North by: Kolongollehena and road (Pradeshiya Sabha); East by: road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South by: Kolongollehena claimed by A.M.K. Nandasiri Abeyrathna Banda, Kolongollehena claimed by A.M.K.Karunarathna Banda and A.M.K.U.Atthanayaka; West by: Kolongollehena. Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4/3/8/2018/PC/76.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,“Mihikatha Medura”, 1200/6,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.10th October, 2023.
